cases.badge: Main Paper Fig. 5 · Shared-Object Coupled Goals
cases.instruction: Clear the obstructing bowl from the cutting board so carrot and broccoli can be placed on the board, and use that same bowl to reheat the waffle inside the microwave.
cases.takeaway: STAGE resolves the shared-object dependency by moving the obstructing bowl off the board, loading the waffle + bowl into the microwave, completing heating via a within-stage VLA→Code handoff (sg012, step 2400), and returning to place vegetables while preserving the heated condition. RPent-Hybrid loses the waffle from the tilted bowl during transport (steps 885–1205); it later places the vegetables on the board, leaving reheating unmet.
